Case studies

What was done.

NADIR

The challenge

The founder wanted to keep green, which carries the sense of health and natural goodness the drinks are built on. The original look felt plain. She wanted the brand and the bottle labels to feel more distinctive, so the range stands out on the shelf.

My approach

Visual storytelling. The story is natural goodness: hibiscus (zobo) flower, tigernut and no preservatives. Green stays as the base, brighter, with vibrant accents. Each flavour gets its own accent. The five petals of the mark represent the hibiscus flower, the main ingredient in zobo drink.

What I built

A custom flower mark, a green and accent colour system, bottle labels for the three flavours, brand guidelines, and a product website with prices and a bulk-savings offer for six or more bottles.

My role and tools

Identity, labels, guidelines and website. Adobe Illustrator and Figma for design, HTML and CSS for the build, Netlify for deployment.

View the live website

Andre Paint

The challenge

The owner wanted a paint brand that feels local, reliable and professional. He gave me open creative freedom and asked me to surprise him with what the website could do.

My approach

Visual storytelling. A trusted local trade brand, shown through a confident palette, clear labels that read well on a shelf, and a website that answers buyers' questions before they call.

What I built

The identity and guidelines, wrap-around bucket labels for the 4-litre and 20-litre tins, and a website with a colour visualizer, a paint calculator and WhatsApp ordering.

My role and tools

Identity, labels, guidelines, website and tools. Adobe Illustrator and Figma for design, HTML and CSS for the build, Netlify for deployment.

Services

What I can deliver for you now.

Brand identity

Logo, colour system, typography and the rules that keep it consistent.

You receive: logo files, colour and type specifications, and a guideline document.

Logo design

A logo or mark built around your business and its story, with variations for web, print and small sizes.

You receive: vector files and usage notes.

Packaging and labels

Label and packaging design for products, with a layout that works across product sizes.

You receive: print-ready artwork.

Website design

A responsive website in HTML and CSS, deployed live, with pages and tools chosen for your customers.

You receive: the live site and the source files.

Brand and website together

The identity and the website designed as one project, so the brand carries through every page.

You receive: identity, guidelines and the live website.

How working with me goes

From first call to final files.

1

Discovery. We talk about your business, your customers and what you want the brand to say. I gather existing materials and agree the scope.

2

Direction. I explore the story and propose a direction with colour, type and mood references before any detailed design.

3

Design. I build the identity, labels or website from the agreed direction.

4

Feedback. You review the work, and we agree changes in a set number of rounds so the timeline stays clear.

5

Delivery. You receive the final files, guidelines where relevant, and the live website if we build one.

Scope, timing and pricing are agreed in writing before work starts.

About

How I got here.

I've always been drawn to how a brand looks and feels before anyone reads a word. Colour, type and shape tell people who a business is, and I want to be the person who gets that right.

I started learning Adobe Illustrator and Inkscape to build logos and marks, then moved into web design. Writing HTML and CSS lets me build the designs I make as real websites, so the work doesn't stop at the mockup.

Before design, I worked as an administrative assistant, coordinating deliverables, client communication and digital asset libraries. That shows in how I work: clear communication, careful file handling, and on-time delivery.

I use AI tools to speed up parts of my workflow, but the creative direction and design decisions stay grounded in each client's needs. I also create AI-assisted motion and promo content, including promotional videos for brands.
